summary: Account statement generator. For each account (via the card cross-reference) it reads the customer and account data and all of the account's transactions, then produces a statement in BOTH plain-text and HTML formats. Transactions are buffered in an in-memory table (up to 51 cards x 10 transactions). Notably uses legacy ALTER + GO TO 'switched paragraph' control flow and reads the mainframe TIOT control blocks to list the job's DD names. Contains unstructured control flow that should be reviewed before modernization.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Walk the mainframe control blocks (PSA -> TCB -> TIOT) to display the running job/step and each DD name (valid or null UCB). Open the statement and HTML output files, initialize the transaction table, then fall into the file-open dispatcher.
branches: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-TIOT OR TIO-LEN = LOW-VALUES

annotations.note: Uses SET ADDRESS OF and pointer arithmetic over MVS control blocks (PSA/TCB/TIOT) -- environment-specific, will not port directly; flag for SME review.

paragraphs.notes: Low-level MVS control-block navigation to enumerate DD names.

paragraphs.name: 0000-START
paragraphs.pseudocode: Dispatcher: based on the current DD-name state (WS-FL-DD), ALTER the shared 8100-FILE-OPEN paragraph to branch to the correct file-open routine (TRNX, XREF, CUST, ACCT) and GO TO it; for 'READTRNX' go to the transaction read; otherwise go to end.
branches: EVALUATE WS-FL-DD: TRNXFILE / XREFFILE / CUSTFILE / ACCTFILE / READTRNX / OTHER

annotations.note: UNSTRUCTURED CONTROL FLOW: uses ALTER ... TO PROCEED TO plus GO TO to reroute a shared paragraph at runtime -- a deprecated construct that must be refactored during modernization; flag for SME review.

paragraphs.notes: ALTER/GO TO dispatcher -- the key modernization hazard.

paragraphs.name: 1000-MAINLINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Loop until end-of-file over the cross-reference: for each card/account, read the customer and account, create the statement, reset the running total, and read the account's transactions.

paragraphs.name: 5000-CREATE-STATEMENT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build the statement header for the account and customer (name/address) and emit it to both the plain-text statement file and the HTML file; prepare per-transaction detail lines and accumulate the statement total.

annotations.note: Transactions are buffered in a table of up to 51 cards x 10 transactions per statement.

paragraphs.name: 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next cross-reference record; at end-of-file set the end flag.

paragraphs.name: 2000-CUSTFILE-GET
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the customer record for the current cross-reference customer id.

paragraphs.name: 3000-ACCTFILE-GET
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account record for the current cross-reference account id.

paragraphs.name: 4000-TRNXFILE-GET
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account's transactions, buffering each into the per-card transaction table and adding its amount to the statement total, until the account's transactions are exhausted.
paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS: gathers transactions and computes statement total.

paragraphs.name: 8100-FILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Shared, ALTER-able open paragraph: at runtime it is redirected (via ALTER) to one of the specific file-open routines.

annotations.note: Target of ALTER -- its behavior changes at runtime; hard to reason about statically. Flag for SME review.

paragraphs.name: 8500-READTRNX-READ
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read a transaction record from the transaction file for the current account.

paragraphs.name: 9999-GOBACK
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the output files and return to the caller.
